items.title: 通膨與地緣風險加劇 印度央行時隔近4年首度升息
items.title_en: Inflation and Geopolitical Risks Intensify as India's Central Bank Raises Rates for First Time in Nearly Four Years
paras: 印度央行(RBI)貨幣政策委員會(MPC)周三(7日)一致通過將基準附買回利率(Repo Rate)調升25個基點(1碼)至5.50%，這是自2023年2月以來近四年首度升息。此外，委員會以4比2的票數，決議將政策立場由「中立」轉為「權衡緊縮」。
印度央行總裁馬洛特拉(Sanjay Malhotra)發布聲明指出：「通膨及其前景已不像去年那般溫和，重新調整政策利率已成為當務之急。」他強調，鑑於當前局勢，短期內已不可能降息，未來的政策行動僅會是升息或暫停升息，端看經濟發展而定。
不過委員會內部出現分歧，外部委員Nagesh Kumar與Ram Singh主張應繼續維持「中立」立場。
受中東衝突推升國際油價突破每桶100美元、季風偏弱及盧比承壓影響，印度央行將2026-27財年的CPI通膨預測由5.0%上調至5.2%。但受益於強勁內需與第一季高達7.8%的經濟成長，央行同步將財年的GDP成長率預測由6.7%大幅上調至7.1%。
針對本次決策，星展銀行(DBS Bank)資深經濟學家Radhika Rao表示，這次升息承認了周期性通膨風險不再溫和，展現出央行強烈的鷹派意圖。
邦罕資產管理公司(Bandhan AMC)債券首席投資長Suyash Choudhary認為，立場轉變是央行致力確保達成通膨目標的及時信號，並預測後續可能還會再升息100個基點。
Capital Economics 資深亞太經濟學家Abhijit Surya指出，鷹派基調支持進一步緊縮，預估央行將於12月與2月各升息1碼，使附買回利率達到6%的頂峰。
paras_en: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) unanimously approved on Wednesday (the 7th) a 25‑basis‑point (one tick) increase in the repo rate to 5.50%, marking the first rate hike in almost four years since February 2023. The committee also voted 4‑2 to shift its policy stance from “neutral” to “leaning restrictive.”

RBI Governor Sanjay Malhotra said in a statement, “Inflation and its outlook are no longer as benign as last year; adjusting the policy rate has become urgent.” He stressed that, given the current situation, a rate cut is not possible in the short term and future policy moves will be limited to further hikes or a pause, depending on economic developments.
However, there was dissent within the committee, with external members Nagesh Kumar and Ram Singh arguing that the “neutral” stance should be maintained.

Because of higher international oil prices driven by Middle‑East conflict—pushing crude above $100 a barrel—weak monsoon and pressure on the rupee, the RBI raised its CPI inflation forecast for FY 2026‑27 from 5.0% to 5.2%. Benefiting from strong domestic demand and a 7.8% growth rate in Q1, the bank also lifted its GDP growth forecast for the fiscal year from 6.7% to 7.1%.
Regarding the decision, senior economist Radhika Rao of DBS Bank said the hike acknowledges that cyclical inflation risks are no longer mild and demonstrates the RBI’s strong hawkish intent.

Bandhan AMC’s chief investment officer for bonds, Suyash Choudhary, said the stance shift is a timely signal of the RBI’s commitment to achieving its inflation target and forecast that another 100 basis points of hikes could follow.

Abhijit Surya, senior Asia‑Pacific economist at Capital Economics, noted that the hawkish tone supports further tightening and projected that the RBI would raise rates by one tick each in December and February, taking the repo rate to a peak of 6%.

items.title: 中國「人造太陽」走出實驗室 核心零件量產、拚2030年前後示範發電
items.title_en: China’s “Artificial Sun” Moves Out of the Lab: Mass Production of Core Components and a Goal to Demonstrate Power Generation Around 2030
paras: 中國「人造太陽」建設加速，可控核融合實驗設備與核心零組件近期密集落地。緊湊型核融合能實驗裝置（BEST）園區交付啟用，超導磁鐵核心零件完成批量交付，民營企業也在自有裝置上實現氫硼核融合反應，推動產業從實驗研究走向工程示範與商業化探索。
據央視新聞報導，BEST計畫園區於中國十一長假前夕正式交付啟用，主機建造進入冷屏等「四環套裝」的關鍵階段，工程重心由土木建設轉向核心設備安裝與系統整合。計畫力拚2027年底完成整體建造，2030年前後進行氘氚核融合發電示範。
BEST由中國科學院等離子體物理研究所主導設計、聚變新能（安徽）公司承建。在此之前，中國已建成全超導托卡馬克裝置「東方超環」（EAST），創下多項穩態高約束運轉紀錄。從EAST物理實驗到BEST工程整合，中國磁約束核融合正加速銜接基礎研究與工程驗證。
核心零組件供應也取得進展。國機重裝旗下二重裝備研發的8件BEST環向磁場（TF）線圈盒，已於9月27日完成製造組裝並出貨，顯示核融合反應爐超導磁鐵核心部件正從科研試製走向批量生產。
TF線圈負責產生約束電漿所需的環向主磁場，製造涉及大型鍛造、精密加工與結構件焊接。隨著相關部件批量交付，上游特種材料、鍛造與加工業者可望獲得更多需求，也為後續裝置建設累積工業製造能力。
民營企業方面，新奧集團9月底宣布，「玄龍-50U」裝置實現氫硼核融合反應，提前達成原訂2026年底的目標。據公司介紹，這是全球商業核融合公司首次在自有裝置上實現氫硼反應。下一代球形環裝置「和龍-2」已全面動工，目標於2030年實現氫硼核融合發電。
氫硼路線具備燃料易取得、無中子輻照及理論發電效率較高等優勢，但技術門檻也更高。中國目前形成國有企業推進較成熟的托卡馬克路線、民營企業探索其他技術與燃料路線的發展格局。
AI算力與資料中心用電需求成長，正推升市場對大規模清潔電力的需求。中國也已將可控核融合納入「十五五」規劃重點，國家資金、產業資本與市場化機構持續投入，支撐長期研發。
不過，核融合大規模商用仍須克服電漿穩態燃燒、材料耐輻照、氚自持與燃料循環等難題。業界認為，2030年前後的發電示範將是重要驗證節點；在此之前，核心部件量產能力、供應鏈自主程度與各路線技術可行性，仍是市場觀察重點。
paras_en: China’s “artificial sun” construction is accelerating, with controlled nuclear‑fusion experimental equipment and core components landing intensively in recent weeks. The compact fusion‑energy experimental device (BEST) campus has been handed over and put into service, superconducting‑magnet core parts have entered batch delivery, and a private‑sector firm has achieved a hydrogen‑boron fusion reaction on its own device, pushing the industry from laboratory research toward engineering demonstration and commercial exploration.

According to CCTV news, the BEST project campus was officially handed over just before the Chinese “Golden Week” holiday, and the main‑machine construction has entered the critical “four‑ring” stage of cold‑screen installation, shifting the engineering focus from civil works to core‑equipment installation and system integration. The plan aims to complete overall construction by the end of 2027 and to carry out a deuterium‑tritium fusion power‑generation demonstration around 2030.

BEST is designed by the Institute of Plasma Physics of the Chinese Academy of Sciences and built by Fusion New Energy (Anhui) Co. Prior to this, China completed the fully superconducting tokamak “EAST” (Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak), setting multiple steady‑state high‑confinement operation records. Moving from EAST’s physics experiments to BEST’s engineering integration, China’s magnetic‑confinement fusion is rapidly bridging basic research and engineering validation.

Progress has also been made on core‑component supply. The eight toroidal‑field (TF) coil boxes for BEST, developed by the second‑equipment division of China National Machinery Heavy Equipment Corp., were completed, assembled and shipped on September 27, showing that superconducting‑magnet core parts for fusion reactors are moving from research‑prototype to batch production.

The TF coils generate the toroidal magnetic field that confines the plasma, and their manufacture involves large‑scale forging, precision machining and structural welding. With batch delivery of these parts, upstream specialty‑material, forging and machining firms can expect increased demand, helping to build industrial manufacturing capacity for later device construction.

On the private‑sector side, New‑Aust Group announced at the end of September that its “Xuanlong‑50U” device achieved a hydrogen‑boron fusion reaction, reaching its original target of the end of 2026 ahead of schedule. The company says this is the first time a commercial fusion firm worldwide has realized a hydrogen‑boron reaction on its own apparatus. Its next‑generation spherical‑torus device “Helong‑2” is now under full construction, aiming to achieve hydrogen‑boron power generation by 2030.

The hydrogen‑boron route offers advantages such as readily available fuel, no neutron radiation and theoretically higher power‑conversion efficiency, but it also poses higher technical barriers. China’s current landscape features state‑owned enterprises advancing the more mature tokamak route, while private firms explore alternative technologies and fuel cycles.

Growing AI‑computing and data‑center power demand is driving up the market need for large‑scale clean electricity. China has also incorporated controlled nuclear fusion into its 15‑Year (2021‑2025) plan, with national funding, industry capital and market‑oriented institutions continuously invested to support long‑term R&D.

Nevertheless, large‑scale commercial fusion still must overcome challenges such as steady‑state plasma burning, material radiation resistance, tritium self‑sufficiency and fuel‑cycle management. Industry views the power‑generation demonstration around 2030 as a key validation milestone; before then, the mass‑production capacity of core parts, the degree of supply‑chain autonomy and the feasibility of various technology routes remain the main points of market focus.

items.title: 法國2027總統大選前哨戰：雷朋提減稅300億、節支1400億歐元
items.title_en: France's 2027 Presidential Election Prelude: Le Pen Proposes €30 billion Tax Cuts and €140 billion Savings
paras: 法國2027年總統大選將至，國民聯盟（RN）率先提出經濟與財政政策主張。該黨國民議會黨團主席雷朋（Marine Le Pen）10月6日在巴黎公布施政方案，提出到2032年相較2026年淨節支1,400億歐元，並承諾五年任期內淨減稅300億歐元，將財政整頓與減稅列為大選政策重點。
據法國媒體報導，雷朋與國民聯盟主席巴德拉（Jordan Bardella）、負責經濟及預算事務的議員唐吉（Jean-Philippe Tanguy）共同出席記者會。公布內容涵蓋2027年替代預算，以及國民聯盟若贏得總統大選後的五年施政規劃。
減稅與削減赤字並進
在總統任期的財政規劃上，雷朋將先前1,250億歐元的淨節支目標提高至1,400億歐元，以2032年相較2026年的水準為準。她承諾，若當選總統，將在就任後18個月內達成不計債務利息支出的基本財政收支平衡，並在2030年將公共赤字占國內生產毛額（GDP）的比例降至3%以下。
雷朋也提出，五年任期內淨減稅300億歐元，並在任期結束時將公共支出占GDP的比例降至50%以下。她希望透過公投，把「財政黃金規則」寫入憲法，使預算安排配合逐步降低債務負擔的目標，長期將公共債務占GDP的比例降至60%。
行政、移民與歐盟繳款成節支重點
為達成財政目標，雷朋提出調整國家行政運作，包括集中管理加值稅收入、取消120多項她認為無用或不合理的稅目，以及削減部分協會支出和對外發展援助。
移民政策也是節支方案的一環。雷朋再次主張收緊移民政策，並在相關福利分配上實施法國公民優先。她也希望將法國對歐盟預算的年度淨貢獻降至50億歐元，並削減企業生產稅。
另一方面，國民聯盟提出160億歐元新增支出，用於支持家庭照顧者、為生育第三個孩子提供經濟支持，以及增加監獄收容名額等項目。
退休改革擬增設儲蓄支柱
退休制度是此次方案的另一項重點。雷朋主張調整現行制度中她認為不公平或效率不佳的措施，長期節省150億至200億歐元，為退休改革提供財政空間。
她也宣布，將提出個人及集體退休儲蓄改革，建立累積制退休金支柱。這套機制主要透過儲蓄與投資累積資金，支付未來退休金，有別於以當期繳費支付當期退休金的現收現付制度。
雷朋先前支持將退休年齡降至62歲，部分情況下則降至60歲。她表示，改革的具體措施將在未來幾週公布。
2027年預算先成攻防焦點
在大選施政規劃之外，國民聯盟同日提出2027年替代預算，列出716億歐元節支措施，為即將展開的國會預算辯論表明立場。
巴德拉提出的措施包括透過精簡及優化支出節省280億歐元，以及削減150億歐元與移民相關的支出。對於政府預算案，他未排除支持不信任動議的可能，同時也保留棄權空間。
雷朋另呼籲歐洲央行採取行動，減輕歐元區國家的利息負擔，為國防與技術追趕等投資騰出財政空間。
paras_en: France’s 2027 presidential election is approaching, and the National Rally (RN) is the first to put forward its economic and fiscal policy proposals. Party leader in the National Assembly Marine Le Pen announced the plan in Paris on October 6, pledging a net saving of €140 billion by 2032 compared with 2026 and a net tax cut of €30 billion over a five‑year term, making fiscal consolidation and tax relief the centerpiece of its election platform.

According to French media, Le Pen was joined at the press conference by RN chairman Jordan Bardella and budget‑focused MP Jean‑Philippe Tanguy. The announcement covered an alternative 2027 budget and the party’s five‑year governance plan should it win the presidency.
Tax cuts and deficit reduction go hand in hand

In the fiscal plan for the presidential term, Le Pen raised the previous net‑saving target from €125 billion to €140 billion, using the 2032 level compared with 2026 as the benchmark. She pledged that, if elected, she would achieve a basic fiscal balance (excluding debt‑interest payments) within 18 months of taking office and would bring the public‑deficit ratio below 3 % of GDP by 2030.

Le Pen also said the five‑year term would see a net tax reduction of €30 billion and that, by the end of the term, public‑spending would fall below 50 % of GDP. She wants a referendum to embed a “golden rule” for public finances in the constitution, aligning budget planning with a gradual debt‑reduction goal that would ultimately bring public‑debt to 60 % of GDP.
Administration, immigration and EU contributions are key saving targets

To hit the fiscal goals, Le Pen proposes reforms to state administration, including centralising value‑added‑tax collection, scrapping more than 120 tax items she deems unnecessary or unreasonable, and cutting certain association spending and foreign‑development aid.

Immigration policy is also part of the saving plan. Le Pen again calls for tighter immigration rules and a “French‑first” approach to related welfare benefits. She also wants to cut France’s net annual contribution to the EU budget to €5 billion and reduce the corporate production tax.
The RN also proposes €16 billion of new spending for measures such as supporting family caregivers, providing financial aid for families having a third child, and expanding prison capacity.
Pension reform to add a savings pillar

Pensions are another focal point of the proposal. Le Pen says she will adjust measures she views as unfair or inefficient in the current system, aiming to save €15‑20 billion in the long run to free fiscal space for pension reform.

She announced a reform of individual and collective pension savings, creating a funded pillar that would accumulate assets through savings and investment to pay future pensions, unlike the current pay‑as‑you‑go system that uses current contributions to fund current retirees.
Le Pen previously supported lowering the statutory retirement age to 62, and in some cases to 60. She said the concrete reform measures will be disclosed in the coming weeks.
2027 budget becomes the focal point of the pre‑election battle
Beyond the election platform, the RN unveiled an alternative 2027 budget on the same day, listing €71.6 billion in saving measures to signal its stance ahead of the parliamentary budget debate.

Bardella’s measures include streamlining and optimising spending to save €28 billion and cutting €15 billion of immigration‑related outlays. He did not rule out supporting a motion of no‑confidence on the government’s budget and kept the option to abstain.
Le Pen also called on the European Central Bank to act, easing interest‑rate burdens on euro‑area countries and freeing fiscal space for defence and technology‑catch‑up investments.

items.title: Google發表開源原生多模態嵌入模型EmbeddingGemma 2 與新一代Gemini 4 Argon
items.title_en: Google Unveils Open‑Source Native Multimodal Embedding Model EmbeddingGemma 2 and Next‑Gen Gemini 4 Argon
paras: Google(GOOGL-US) 周二(7日)正式發表全新人工智慧模型，包含首款採用 Apache 2.0 授權條款的開源原生多模態嵌入模型 EmbeddingGemma 2，以及具備高達 100 萬 Token 輸出限制的旗艦級語言模型 Gemini 4 Argon。
Google 執行長 Sundar Pichai 表示，EmbeddingGemma 2 為 Google 第一個開放原始碼且原生支援多模態的嵌入模型，機能將文字、程式碼、圖像、視訊與音訊統一定位在單一向量空間中，方便開發者於消費級裝置上進行高效搜尋與檢索。

EmbeddingGemma 2：輕量化架構與裝置端運算

EmbeddingGemma 2 採用基於 Gemma 4 的模組化架構，總參數量為 7.4 億(740M)。模型結構由 2.7 億參數的純文字主幹、1.7 億參數的視覺編碼器，以及 3 億參數的音訊編碼器組成。在實際應用中，開發者可依據需求僅載入純文字模態(270M)或結合視覺與音訊模態，彈性調配硬體資源。
在裝置端(On-device)執行效能方面，經量化處理後的 EmbeddingGemma 2 在 Google Pixel 11 Pro 上運作時，純文字模式僅需約 191MB 的活躍記憶體，而完整多模態版本約需 567MB。此外，模型將上下文視窗擴展至 8,000(8K)Token，為前一代產品的 4 倍，單次可在本地端處理長達 5.5 分鐘的音訊、29 張圖像或 58 幀視訊。
為降低本地向量資料庫的記憶體負擔，EmbeddingGemma 2 導入了 Matryoshka 表示學習(MRL) 技術，允許將預設的 768 維輸出向量彈性截取至 512、256 或 128 維，最高可節省 6 倍儲存空間。在基準測試表現上，其於 MTEB Code 程式碼檢索測試中取得 78.68 分，相較前代的 68.76 分進步了 9.92 分，顯著提升了本地程式碼庫索引與檢索的效能。

開源權重三大優勢：自主控制、隱私安全與高效運算

相較於閉源 API 服務，開放模型權重的首要優勢在於避免供應商鎖定與系統崩潰風險。若閉源服務調整策略或將模型下線，開發者存於向量資料庫中的歷史向量皆需重新計算；而開源權重下載至本地硬體後，開發者能享有完全的系統自主控制權。
其次，開放權重支援邊緣裝置(On-device)運作與高隱私防護。機密文件與多模態資料無需上傳至雲端伺服器，即可於本地直接生成嵌入向量，能顯著降低資料傳輸延遲。經量化處理後，在智慧型手機(如 Pixel 11 Pro)上運作時，純文字模式僅需約 191MB 活躍記憶體。
最後，開放權重能無縫整合至社群生態系與開源工具鏈，並支援開發者針對特定領域進行客製化微調。

Gemini 4 Argon：百萬Token 輸出的旗艦模型

在發表 EmbeddingGemma 2 的同時，Google 推出了新一代旗艦模型 Gemini 4 Argon。該模型主打長工作流程(Long-horizon workflows)，專為複雜軟體工程、法律文件撰寫、金融研究與網路安全防衛等任務打造。
Gemini 4 Argon 的最大技術特點在於將單次回應的輸出上限大幅提升至 100 萬(1M)Token，遠高於先前機型的 64,000 Token，使其能在單一流程中完成深入推理與長篇程式碼生成。
對於模型效能，Google DeepMind 資深副總裁 Koray Kavukcuoglu 將 Gemini 4 Argon 定位為「前沿智慧新時代」的開端。在 Google 公布的 18 項效能評測中，Gemini 4 Argon 在其中的 12 項測試中超越了 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Astra 與 Anthropic 的 Claude Opus 5.5。
在發行策略上，Google 目前優先將 Gemini 4 Argon 提供給參與「Fairwind 計畫」的全球 650 多家資安合作夥伴與政府防護機構使用。
定價方面，發表初期的促銷價格為每百萬輸入 Token 2 美元、輸出 Token 10 美元，未來將回升至 4 美元與 20 美元。至於一般 API 與 Google AI Ultra 訂閱者的開放時間，官方表示將會在後續階段陸續推動。
paras_en: Google (GOOGL‑US) on Tuesday the 7th officially announced a new suite of AI models, including the first open‑source native multimodal embedding model under an Apache 2.0 license, EmbeddingGemma 2, and the flagship language model Gemini 4 Argon with a maximum output limit of one million tokens.

CEO Sundar Pichai said EmbeddingGemma 2 is Google’s first open‑source, natively multimodal embedding model, capable of mapping text, code, images, video and audio into a single vector space, making efficient search and retrieval on consumer devices easier for developers.

EmbeddingGemma 2: lightweight architecture and on‑device inference. Built on a modular Gemma 4‑based design, the model has 740 million parameters: a 270 million‑parameter pure‑text backbone, a 170 million‑parameter visual encoder, and a 300 million‑parameter audio encoder. Developers can load only the text modality (270 M) or combine visual and audio modalities as needed, flexibly allocating hardware resources.

On‑device performance after quantization shows EmbeddingGemma 2 using about 191 MB of active memory for the pure‑text mode on a Google Pixel 11 Pro, while the full multimodal version requires roughly 567 MB. The context window is expanded to 8,000 tokens—four times the previous generation—allowing a single local run to handle up to 5.5 minutes of audio, 29 images, or 58 video frames.

To reduce the memory load of local vector databases, EmbeddingGemma 2 incorporates Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), letting the default 768‑dimensional output vectors be truncated to 512, 256 or 128 dimensions, saving up to six‑fold in storage. In benchmark tests it scored 78.68 on the MTEB Code retrieval suite, up 9.92 points from the prior 68.76, markedly improving local code‑base indexing and search.

Three major advantages of open‑source weights: self‑control, privacy security and efficient computation. Compared with closed‑source APIs, open weights avoid vendor lock‑in and system‑failure risk; if a closed service changes policy or is discontinued, developers would have to recompute all vectors stored in their databases, whereas locally downloaded weights give full system control.

Second, open weights support on‑device operation and high privacy protection. Sensitive documents and multimodal data can be embedded locally without uploading to the cloud, dramatically cutting transmission latency. After quantization, the pure‑text mode runs on a smartphone such as the Pixel 11 Pro with only about 191 MB of active memory.
Finally, open weights can be seamlessly integrated into community ecosystems and open‑source toolchains, and enable developers to fine‑tune the model for specific domains.

Gemini 4 Argon: a flagship model with million‑token output. Alongside EmbeddingGemma 2, Google launched the next‑generation flagship Gemini 4 Argon, marketed for long‑horizon workflows and built for complex software engineering, legal drafting, financial research and cybersecurity tasks.

The key technical highlight of Gemini 4 Argon is its single‑response output ceiling of one million tokens, far exceeding the previous 64,000‑token limit, enabling deep reasoning and extensive code generation within a single workflow.

Regarding performance, Google DeepMind senior vice‑president Koray Kavukcuoglu positioned Gemini 4 Argon as the start of a “new era of frontier intelligence.” In Google’s 18 benchmark tests, Gemini 4 Argon outperformed OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra and Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5 in 12 of them.
In terms of rollout, Google is initially offering Gemini 4 Argon to more than 650 global cybersecurity partners and government protection agencies participating in the “Fairwind” program.

Pricing at launch is $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with future rates expected to rise to $4 and $20 respectively. Availability for general API users and Google AI Ultra subscribers will be phased in during later stages.

items.title: AI記憶體熱潮讓美光賺翻 小摩估自由現金流破1000億美元
items.title_en: AI Memory Boom Sends Micron Soaring; JPMorgan Estimates Free Cash Flow Over $100 Billion
paras: 美光科技(MU-US) 的 AI 熱潮，可能正帶來記憶體晶片業者少見的優勢：龐大且愈來愈可預測的現金流。
摩根大通預估，美光從 2027 會計年度第二季至第四季，累計自由現金流將超過 1,000 億美元，讓這檔 AI 記憶體概念股，進一步增添回饋股東的潛在題材。
這項現金流展望，建立在摩根大通預期記憶體供應將持續高度吃緊的基礎上。
分析師 Harlan Sur 表示，美光管理層預期，2027 年及 2028 年的供需情勢將比 2026 年更加緊張，記憶體需求增幅將遠高於產業供給增幅。摩根大通估計，2027 年產業供給缺口約為 19%，2028 年則約為 15% 至 16%。
這點格外關鍵，因為美光進入這波景氣上行循環時，對未來價格的掌握程度高於以往。公司目前已簽訂 26 份策略客戶協議，涵蓋截至 2030 年預估營收的逾 35%，部分協議更延續至 2031 年。包含現金訂金在內的客戶承諾金額已升至 320 億美元，剩餘履約義務則達 1,500 億美元。
美光最新財報也展現這波成長動能。2026 會計年度營收從前一年的 374 億美元躍升至 1,332 億美元，調整後自由現金流達 623 億美元。
投資人目前最關心的問題，可能已轉向美光將如何運用這筆現金。
管理層表示，股票回購將是把多餘現金返還股東的主要方式。摩根大通預期，美光將尋求大幅提高回購授權額度，遠高於現有的 22 億美元計畫。
時點也相當重要。美光先前受到《晶片法案》補助相關限制，股票回購因而受限。管理層預期，公司將在截至 11 月的季度達到目標現金水位，並表明有意逐步將多餘現金全數返還股東，且優先回購股票，其次才是發放股利。
這可能形成強勁的正向循環：記憶體供應吃緊支撐價格，價格走強推升現金流，充沛現金流則讓美光更有能力透過回購減少流通股數。
摩根大通給予美光「增持」評等，設定 2027 年 12 月目標價為 1,540 美元，相較之下，10 月 5 日股價為 1,063.96 美元。其估值依據約為 2027 年預估獲利的 8 倍本益比。
風險在於，記憶體仍是景氣循環產業。若供給擴張速度超出預期、AI 支出減弱，或記憶體價格下跌，都可能迅速動搖上述現金流預估。
這也正是美光新簽長期合約的重要性所在。若公司能將當前 AI 帶動的記憶體短缺，轉化為未來數年的價格能見度與龐大自由現金流，下一個推升股價的催化因素，可能不再是獲利超出預期，而是公司如何運用手上的現金。
paras_en: Micron Technology (MU-US)’s AI boom may be delivering a rare advantage to memory chip makers: massive and increasingly predictable cash flow.
JPMorgan estimates that Micron’s cumulative free cash flow from Q2 to Q4 of fiscal 2027 will exceed $100 billion, adding another shareholder‑return theme to this AI‑memory concept stock.
This cash‑flow outlook is based on JPMorgan’s expectation that memory supply will remain tightly constrained.

Analyst Harlan Sur said Micron’s management expects the supply‑demand balance in 2027 and 2028 to be tighter than in 2026, with memory demand growth far outpacing industry supply growth. JPMorgan estimates the industry supply gap at about 19% in 2027 and roughly 15%‑16% in 2028.

This is especially critical because Micron is entering this up‑cycle with greater control over future pricing than before. The company has already signed 26 strategic customer agreements covering more than 35% of revenue projected through 2030, some extending to 2031. Including cash deposits, customer commitments have risen to $32 billion, with remaining performance obligations of $150 billion.
Micron’s latest earnings also show the growth momentum. Fiscal 2026 revenue jumped from $37.4 billion the prior year to $133.2 billion, and adjusted free cash flow reached $62.3 billion.
Investors’ most pressing question now may have shifted to how Micron will deploy this cash.

Management said share repurchases will be the primary way to return excess cash to shareholders. JPMorgan expects Micron to seek a substantial increase in its repurchase authorization, far above the current $2.2 billion plan.

Timing is also crucial. Micron was previously limited in buybacks by restrictions tied to the CHIPS Act subsidies. Management expects the company to hit its target cash level by the quarter ending November and has indicated an intention to gradually return all excess cash to shareholders, prioritizing share repurchases before dividends.

This could create a strong positive feedback loop: tight memory supply supports prices, higher prices boost cash flow, and abundant cash flow gives Micron more capacity to reduce shares outstanding through buybacks.

JPMorgan gives Micron an ‘overweight’ rating and sets a 2027‑12 target price of $1,540, compared with the October 5 share price of $1,063.96. The valuation is roughly an 8× forward earnings multiple for 2027.
Risks remain because memory is still a cyclical industry. If supply expands faster than expected, AI spending eases, or memory prices fall, the cash‑flow forecasts could be quickly undermined.

That underscores the importance of Micron’s new long‑term contracts. If the company can turn the current AI‑driven memory shortage into price visibility and massive free cash flow for years to come, the next catalyst for the stock may no longer be earnings surprises but how the firm uses the cash on hand.

items.title: 緩解記憶體缺貨危機！超微蘇姿丰會三星全永鉉 鞏固供應鏈
items.title_en: Alleviating the Memory Shortage Crisis! AMD’s Lisa Su to Meet Samsung’s Jun Young-hyun to Strengthen Supply Chain
paras: 超微(AMD-US)執行長蘇姿丰(Lisa Su)計劃周三(7日)在南韓與三星電子半導體事業負責人會面，是這兩位人工智慧(AI)產業關鍵人物最近一次面對面交流。
知情人士透露，這是蘇姿丰七個月內第二度造訪首爾，屆時將與負責關鍵晶片事業的三星電子副董事長全永鉉(Jun Young-hyun)會面。三星電子與超微均拒絕置評。
目前各類記憶體產品普遍短缺，而記憶體價格持續飆升，已成為資料中心營運商最大的成本之一。超微今年3月與三星電子達成供應協議，三星將向超微供應新一代高頻寬記憶體(HBM)以及先進記憶體晶片。
南韓在全球科技生態系中占有關鍵地位，既是AI硬體主要供應國，也是重要消費市場，三星電子及同業SK海力士(SK Hynix)等企業，投入總額達8800億美元的資金，用於AI時代的數位基礎建設與資料中心。與此同時，南韓主要電信、製造業及網路平台企業也正積極加碼投資AI資料中心及新一代企業服務。
蘇姿丰周二在台北表示，超微計劃於2027年增加晶片供應，以滿足AI應用持續成長的需求。她表示，此次訪台的目的之一，是確保超微的供應鏈能夠提升CPU及GPU的生產能力，以滿足AI需求。
為此她已與鴻海(2317-TW)進行會面，並計劃與台積電(2330-TW)展開會談，作為與在地合作夥伴溝通的一環。
paras_en: AMD CEO Lisa Su plans to meet with Samsung Electronics’ semiconductor head on Wednesday (the 7th) in South Korea, marking the latest face‑to‑face exchange between these two key AI industry figures.

Sources say this will be Su’s second visit to Seoul within seven months, during which she will meet Samsung Electronics Vice Chairman Jun Young‑hyun, who oversees the critical chip business. Both Samsung and AMD declined to comment.

Memory products are currently in widespread shortage and prices keep soaring, becoming one of the biggest cost items for data‑center operators. In March this year AMD struck a supply deal with Samsung, under which Samsung will provide AMD with next‑generation high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced memory chips.

South Korea holds a pivotal role in the global tech ecosystem, serving both as a major AI‑hardware supplier and an important consumer market. Companies such as Samsung and peer SK Hynix have collectively invested about $880 billion in digital infrastructure and data‑center development for the AI era. At the same time, the country’s leading telecom, manufacturing and online platform firms are also ramping up investments in AI data centers and next‑generation enterprise services.

Su said in Taipei on Tuesday that AMD plans to increase chip supply by 2027 to meet the growing demand for AI applications. She added that one purpose of her Taiwan visit was to ensure AMD’s supply chain can boost CPU and GPU production capacity to satisfy AI needs.
To that end she has met with Foxconn (2317‑TW) and plans to hold talks with TSMC (2330‑TW) as part of her outreach to local partners.

items.title: 巴菲特也沉迷YouTube？96歲投資大師都在看什麼
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，Netflix與YouTube已經取代傳統電視，成為觀眾主要的影音娛樂來源，這股趨勢似乎連96歲的「股神」巴菲特(Warren Buffett)也難以抵擋。
巴菲特如今已不再擔任波克夏海瑟威(Berkshire Hathaway)董事長，可能有更多時間觀看Alphabet旗下平台YouTube上的影片。
許多人可能會想像巴菲特平時在閱讀報紙或收看新聞，但《華爾街日報》一篇報導指出，巴菲特近來花了更多時間觀看YouTube影片。
巴菲特的好友Sharon Osberg透露，她最近造訪巴菲特位於內布拉斯加州奧馬哈(Omaha)的住家，兩人花了好幾個小時一起觀看YouTube影片。
Osberg談到，「他看的內容非常廣泛，有時甚至是最無厘頭的東西。」
兩人在YouTube上觀看的內容包括：

美國演員Glenn Close影片片段
1950年代的電視廣告
加拿大出生的美國歌手Paul Anka的影片
烏茲別克版「美國達人秀」(America's Got Talent)


Osberg提到，「我們看了一部非常精彩的Roy Cohn紀錄片，還有烏茲別克版的『美國達人秀』。」
他透露，巴菲特會坐在躺椅上，用電視觀看YouTube。除了演算法推薦的內容之外，他也會觀看與波克夏海瑟威相關的影片。
巴菲特也一直在觀看多年商業夥伴蒙格(Charlie Munger)的舊影片，其中包括蒙格2018年在密西根大學發表的一場演講。
Osberg表示，「你會感受到他們兩人之間的深厚情誼，而華倫看著查理時，那種感覺真的很特別。」
YouTube目前是美國收視最高的影音平台，而電視觀看量持續成長，也讓YouTube得以觸及像巴菲特這樣的新觀眾，不再只依賴數百萬名透過手機及其他串流裝置觀看的用戶。
除了晚上觀看YouTube外，巴菲特還有其他收視習慣，例如在早上觀看CNBC。巴菲特過去也曾不時接受該頻道訪問。
巴菲特也喜歡觀看Turner Classic Movies(TCM)，這個專門播放老電影的頻道目前由Paramount Skydance持有。TCM經常播放巴菲特最喜歡的電影之一「十二怒漢」(12 Angry Men)。
在卸下執行長職務之前，巴菲特曾投資Alphabet股票，並讓Alphabet成為波克夏投資組合中規模最大持股之一。
截至第二季末，Alphabet A類股(GOOGL-US)是波克夏第四大持股，價值達282億美元，占投資資產9.4%，C類股(GOOG-US)則是第十大持股，價值96億美元，占資產3.2%。兩類股票合計持股價值約380億美元。

items.title: EmbeddingGemma 2登場！Google AI搜尋可離線跑 語音找影片 文字搜音訊
items.title_en: EmbeddingGemma 2 Arrives! Google AI Search Can Run Offline, Voice‑Find Videos, Text‑Search Audio
paras: Alphabet (GOOGL-US)旗下Google DeepMind宣布推出新一代開放式多模態嵌入模型EmbeddingGemma 2，將原本以文字為主的EmbeddingGemma擴充至程式碼、圖片、影片及音訊，並把不同類型的資料映射到同一個768維向量空間，讓開發者可以在裝置本地直接進行跨模態搜尋、資料檢索及生成式AI應用。
EmbeddingGemma 2建立於Gemma 4架構，擁有7.4億個參數，採Apache 2.0授權，可用於商業產品。Google表示，這款模型的設計重點是以較小的模型規模提供多模態嵌入能力，讓AI搜尋及檢索工作可以直接在手機、個人電腦等消費性硬體上執行，而不必將資料全部傳送至雲端。
EmbeddingGemma 2採模組化架構，文字與程式碼功能只需要2.7億個參數，加入視覺編碼器後為4.4億個參數，加入音訊編碼器後為5.7億個參數，完整啟用文字、程式碼、圖片、影片與音訊功能則使用7.4億個參數。視覺編碼器增加1.7億個參數，音訊編碼器增加3億個參數，開發者可以按照實際需求選擇需要載入的模組。
這種設計讓EmbeddingGemma 2能夠將不同來源的資訊放進同一個語意空間。例如，使用者可以輸入文字搜尋特定照片，也可以利用語音備忘錄尋找相關影片片段，甚至以文字查詢數小時的音訊內容。不同模態的資料雖然經過不同編碼器處理，最後仍會被轉換成可以直接比較語意相似度的向量。
Google表示，EmbeddingGemma 2特別適合需要本地搜尋及檢索的應用，包括個人媒體庫搜尋、文件及程式碼搜尋、影音資料檢索，以及結合生成式AI的檢索增強生成(RAG)系統。由於嵌入運算可以直接在裝置上完成，開發者可降低資料傳輸需求與延遲，同時提高隱私保護能力，部分應用也能在沒有網路連線的情況下運作。
EmbeddingGemma 2的上下文視窗擴大至8192個token，是第一代EmbeddingGemma的4倍。在單一模態、沒有加入文字的情況下，模型最多可處理約5.5分鐘音訊、29張圖片或58個影片畫面，也能處理文字與多種媒體交錯的輸入。
在效能方面，Google表示EmbeddingGemma 2在MTEB Code測試的分數從第一代的68.76提高至78.68，增加9.92分。Google開發者資料則指出，這相當於約14%的效能提升，同時維持第一代EmbeddingGemma在多語言文字上的表現，並進一步加入圖片、影片及音訊檢索能力。
EmbeddingGemma 2也採用Matryoshka Representation Learning(MRL)，讓開發者可以把原本768維的輸出向量動態縮減至512、256或128維，以降低向量資料庫的儲存與記憶體需求。Google表示，最多可以降低約6倍儲存需求。
其中，使用256維向量時，文字及程式碼仍可保留大部分原始嵌入品質，而圖片、影片及語音檢索約可維持95%的原始品質，儲存空間則可降至原本約三分之一。若進一步縮減至128維，文字及程式碼約可維持90%品質，但圖片、影片及語音檢索品質可能降至約75%，因此較適合大型文字索引或第一階段搜尋篩選。
Google開發者指南指出，在bfloat16精度下，儲存100萬個768維向量約需要1.5GB記憶體，若縮減至128維，則約需要250MB，代表相同記憶體容量下可以儲存約6倍數量的嵌入向量。
在裝置端執行效率方面，Google表示，經量化後，EmbeddingGemma 2在Pixel 11 Pro上執行文字版本時，主動RAM需求最低約191MB；完整多模態版本則約需要567MB。這使模型能夠在相對有限的裝置資源下執行，而不必依賴大型雲端運算基礎設施。
EmbeddingGemma 2也可以與Gemma 4搭配使用，建立完整的裝置端RAG流程。由於兩者共享文字tokenizer及音訊編碼器架構，Google表示，開發者可以降低兩個模型同時運作時的整體記憶體占用，讓嵌入、搜尋及生成式推理能夠在同一套本地AI流程中完成。
在實際應用上，Google AI Edge Gallery已展示Instant Media Search及Video Moments Finder等功能。前者可利用文字或圖片在裝置上的媒體資料庫尋找語意相近內容，後者則能利用文字或音訊搜尋影片中的特定片段。Google也展示將EmbeddingGemma 2與Gemma 4結合，用於本地檔案檢索及後續內容理解。
除了搜尋與RAG，EmbeddingGemma 2也可以用於分類、路由及即時決策。Google表示，開發者可以透過MediaPipe Decision Task API利用多模態資訊建立即時決策引擎，進一步把模型應用在需要根據文字、圖片、音訊及影片內容做判斷的裝置端AI系統。
EmbeddingGemma 2的推出也延續第一代EmbeddingGemma的開發者生態。Google表示，第一代EmbeddingGemma自去年推出後已累積超過2000萬次下載，開發者利用它建立裝置端搜尋工具及強調隱私的RAG系統。此次第二代模型則將應用範圍從文字擴展到多種媒體格式。

在開發工具方面，EmbeddingGemma 2可透過sentence-transformers 6.1.0以上版本使用，也支援Transformers、MLX、vLLM、llama.cpp、SGLang、Ollama及LM Studio等工具。開發者可以透過Google AI Edge的MediaPipe進行嵌入、檢索及決策任務，也能使用LiteRT進行自訂模型整合，並可透過transformers.js及WebGPU在瀏覽器環境部署。
模型權重目前可在Hugging Face及Kaggle取得，Google也表示，未來將在Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Model Garden提供相關模型。針對需要進一步調整模型的開發者，Google同時提供Unsloth微調工具的相關支援。
EmbeddingGemma 2另一項重要特色是所有模組仍使用相容的768維共享向量空間。這意味著開發者即使一開始只建立文字索引，日後若要加入圖片或音訊，也不必重新計算既有嵌入資料，只需載入額外編碼器即可擴充系統。
Google表示，EmbeddingGemma 2的核心目標是讓多模態搜尋與檢索能力從雲端進一步下沉至終端裝置。對開發者而言，這不僅可以降低延遲及雲端運算成本，也能讓敏感資料留在使用者裝置內。隨著AI應用逐漸從單純文字互動走向同時理解圖片、聲音、影片及程式碼，能夠在有限硬體資源下處理多模態資料的嵌入模型，將成為建立新一代裝置端AI應用的重要基礎。
paras_en: Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) subsidiary Google DeepMind announced the launch of a new generation open‑multimodal embedding model, EmbeddingGemma 2, expanding the originally text‑focused EmbeddingGemma to code, images, video and audio, and mapping all data types into a single 768‑dimensional vector space so developers can perform cross‑modal search, retrieval and generative‑AI tasks locally on devices.

EmbeddingGemma 2 is built on the Gemma 4 architecture, has 740 million parameters, is released under the Apache 2.0 license and can be used in commercial products. Google says the model is designed to provide multimodal embedding capability with a relatively small footprint, enabling AI search and retrieval to run directly on consumer hardware such as phones and PCs without sending all data to the cloud.

EmbeddingGemma 2 uses a modular design: the text‑and‑code component requires only 270 million parameters, adding the visual encoder brings it to 440 million, adding the audio encoder to 570 million, and the full model with text, code, images, video and audio uses 740 million parameters. The visual encoder adds 170 million parameters, the audio encoder adds 300 million, and developers can load only the modules they need.

This design lets EmbeddingGemma 2 place information from different sources into the same semantic space. For example, a user can type a query to find a specific photo, use a voice memo to locate a related video clip, or query hours of audio content with text. Although each modality is processed by a different encoder, the outputs are converted into vectors that can be directly compared for semantic similarity.

Google says EmbeddingGemma 2 is especially suited for applications that require local search and retrieval, including personal media‑library search, document and code search, audio‑visual data retrieval, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG) systems that combine generative AI. Because embedding computation can run on‑device, developers can reduce data‑transfer needs and latency while improving privacy, and some use cases can operate without an internet connection.

EmbeddingGemma 2’s context window expands to 8,192 tokens, four times that of the first‑generation model. In a single‑modality setting without text, the model can handle roughly 5.5 minutes of audio, 29 images or 58 video frames, and it also supports mixed inputs of text and multiple media types.

In terms of performance, Google reports that EmbeddingGemma 2’s score on the MTEB Code benchmark rose from 68.76 in the first generation to 78.68, an increase of 9.92 points—about a 14 % gain—while preserving the multilingual text performance of the original and adding image, video and audio retrieval capabilities.

EmbeddingGemma 2 also employs Matryoshka Representation Learning (MRL), allowing developers to dynamically shrink the original 768‑dimensional output vectors to 512, 256 or 128 dimensions to cut storage and memory requirements. Google says this can reduce storage needs by up to roughly sixfold.

When using 256‑dimensional vectors, text and code retain most of the original embedding quality, while image, video and audio retrieval maintain about 95 % of the original quality, and storage drops to about one‑third of the original. Reducing further to 128 dimensions keeps roughly 90 % quality for text and code, but image, video and audio quality may fall to around 75 %, making this setting better suited for large text indexes or first‑stage filtering.

Google’s developer guide notes that storing one million 768‑dimensional vectors in bfloat16 precision requires about 1.5 GB of memory; reducing them to 128 dimensions cuts the requirement to roughly 250 MB, meaning the same memory can hold about six times as many embeddings.

Regarding on‑device efficiency, Google says that after quantization, the text‑only version of EmbeddingGemma 2 runs on a Pixel 11 Pro with a minimum active RAM usage of about 191 MB, while the full multimodal version needs roughly 567 MB. This allows the model to operate on relatively limited device resources without relying on large cloud‑compute infrastructure.

EmbeddingGemma 2 can also be paired with Gemma 4 to build a complete on‑device RAG pipeline. Because the two share the same text tokenizer and audio encoder architecture, developers can lower overall memory consumption when both models run simultaneously, enabling embedding, retrieval and generative inference within a single local AI workflow.

In practice, Google AI Edge Gallery has demonstrated features such as Instant Media Search and Video Moments Finder. The former uses text or images to locate semantically similar content in a device’s media library, while the latter lets users search for specific video segments using text or audio. Google also showed a combined EmbeddingGemma 2 + Gemma 4 setup for local file retrieval and subsequent content understanding.

Beyond search and RAG, EmbeddingGemma 2 can be used for classification, routing and real‑time decision‑making. Google says developers can leverage the MediaPipe Decision Task API to build real‑time decision engines that ingest multimodal information, extending the model’s use to device‑side AI systems that must judge based on text, images, audio and video content.

The launch of EmbeddingGemma 2 continues the developer ecosystem built around the first generation. Google notes that the original EmbeddingGemma, released last year, has been downloaded over 20 million times, with developers using it to create on‑device search tools and privacy‑focused RAG systems. The second generation expands the application scope from text to multiple media formats.

For development tools, EmbeddingGemma 2 is usable via sentence‑transformers ≥ 6.1.0 and is also supported by Transformers, MLX, vLLM, llama.cpp, SGLang, Ollama and LM Studio. Developers can perform embedding, retrieval and decision tasks through Google AI Edge’s MediaPipe, integrate custom models with LiteRT, and deploy in browsers using transformers.js and WebGPU.

Model weights are currently available on Hugging Face and Kaggle, and Google says they will also be offered through the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform Model Garden. For developers needing further fine‑tuning, Google provides support for the Unsloth fine‑tuning toolkit.

Another key feature of EmbeddingGemma 2 is that all modules continue to use a compatible 768‑dimensional shared vector space. This means that even if a developer initially builds only a text index, they can later add image or audio capabilities without recomputing existing embeddings—simply load the additional encoders to expand the system.

Google states that the core goal of EmbeddingGemma 2 is to push multimodal search and retrieval from the cloud down to edge devices. For developers, this not only reduces latency and cloud‑compute costs but also keeps sensitive data on the user’s device. As AI applications move beyond pure text interaction toward simultaneous understanding of images, sound, video and code, embedding models that can handle multimodal data on limited hardware will become a foundational building block for the next generation of on‑device AI applications.

items.title: 啟新生技與先進能簽署MOU 共同推動再生醫療分析技術接軌國際
items.title_en: Qixin Biotech and Xianjin Smart Sign MOU to Jointly Advance Regenerative Medicine Analysis Technology Toward International Standards
paras: 啟新生技與先勁智能簽署合作備忘錄(MOU)，雙方結合細胞分析與臨床應用能力，接軌美國國家標準技術研究院(NIST)Flow Cytometry Standards Consortium(FCSC)國際標準化研究，建立具一致性與可比性的細胞分析能力，推動台灣再生醫療分析技術與國際接軌。
啟新表示，隨著再生醫療產品從研發走向臨床應用，細胞分析的一致性與跨實驗室可比性，已成為產品品質與效能評估的重要基礎。目前各研究與醫療單位缺乏共同的分析方法與比較基準，相同細胞檢體可能產生不同結果，造成產業資源重複投入，降低產品開發與技術轉譯效率。
因此，此次合作啟新將結合細胞培養、製程開發及品質檢測等資源，推動跨醫療中心平行比對並累積台灣在地分析數據；先勁智能則運用生醫數據分析、人工智慧及臨床應用能力，協助跨實驗室數據分析比較，導入國際標準化研究經驗，雙方共同推動細胞分析方法一致性與數據可比性。
未來雙方將進一步發展細胞產品效能試驗，讓細胞分析能力從「測得出來」延伸至「結果可比較、方法可驗證、功能可評估」，建立支援再生醫療產品研發、製程開發、品質監測及臨床轉譯的技術基礎。
paras_en: Qixin Biotech and Xianjin Smart have signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to combine their cell‑analysis and clinical‑application capabilities, linking up with the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) Flow Cytometry Standards Consortium (FCSC) international standardization effort. The partnership aims to establish consistent and comparable cell‑analysis capacity and to bring Taiwan’s regenerative‑medicine analysis technology in line with global standards.

Qixin notes that as regenerative‑medicine products move from R&D to clinical use, consistency and inter‑lab comparability of cell analysis have become essential foundations for product quality and efficacy assessment. Currently, research and medical institutions lack common analytical methods and reference benchmarks, so the same cell sample can yield different results, leading to duplicated resource investment and reduced efficiency in product development and technology translation.

Accordingly, the collaboration will see Qixin contribute resources in cell culture, process development and quality testing to drive parallel comparisons across medical centers and to accumulate local analytical data in Taiwan. Xianjin Smart will apply biomedical data analytics, artificial intelligence and clinical expertise to assist inter‑lab data comparison, introduce international standardization experience, and jointly promote consistency of cell‑analysis methods and data comparability.

Going forward, the two parties will further develop efficacy testing for cell products, extending cell‑analysis capability from “measurable” to “results comparable, methods verifiable, functions assessable.” This will create a technical foundation that supports regenerative‑medicine product R&D, process development, quality monitoring and clinical translation.

items.title: 技嘉(2376)9月營收衝631億元！超越市場預期8.2%，AI伺服器放量後獲利能跟上？
paras: 2026年10月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器出貨持續擴大，正改變技嘉(2376-TW)過去以主機板、顯示卡為主的營運結構。技嘉(2376-TW)公布9月營收630.99億元，月增33.12%、年增125.44%，首度突破600億元，創下單月歷史新高。
第三季營收達1,547.13億元，季增7.28%、年增94.41%；累計前三季營收4,039.82億元，年增63.17%，單季與累計營收同步改寫紀錄。公司在營收公告中指出，成長主要來自AI訂單需求暢旺。
根據優分析產業資料庫，以最近更新日期為8月25日的市場預估比較，技嘉(2376-TW)9月營收高於預估8.2%，前三季累計營收也高出約4%，顯示實際出貨表現已超越當時市場設定的成長軌跡。
不過，營收創高能否帶動獲利同步提升，仍須回到產品組合與成本觀察。第二季營收雖較第一季明顯增加，毛利率與營業利益率卻雙雙下滑，第三季財報將成為下一個驗證點。
(圖片來源：優分析產業資料庫)

從單機走向整櫃，營收放大後更要看獲利品質
技嘉(2376-TW)在5月15日法說會中指出，AI需求並非集中於單一平台，GB系列導入比重可望提高，成熟的HGX與RTX產品也持續成長。9月出貨仍以HGX機型為主，顯示既有平台已支撐營收創高，後續則看高規格機櫃能否接續放量。
公司也由單機供應延伸至整櫃運算、模組化資料中心及軟體管理，增加單一專案可提供的產品與服務；並規劃擴充台灣、美國及馬來西亞產能，當時預期全年伺服器產能較去年翻倍，庫存增加則主要為已確認訂單備貨。
不過，營收放大不代表獲利率同步提高，第二季營收1,442.14億元，季增37.2%，毛利率卻由12.01%降至9.62%，營業利益率由7.06%降至5.63%。即使雙率下滑，營收規模擴大仍支撐歸屬母公司淨利季增25.4%，EPS達9.86元。
第三季營收再創高後，關鍵是毛利率與營業利益率能否止穩、營業利益能否持續增加，並確認備貨及出貨成長能順利轉化為現金回收。

地端AI新品推出，新增貢獻仍待出貨驗證
除了資料中心，技嘉(2376-TW)也持續延伸地端AI產品布局，9月30日正式推出AI TOP 100 B850桌上型電腦，鎖定開發團隊、研究機構與企業的模型微調及推論需求，提供NVIDIA RTX 5090單卡與AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700雙卡配置。
這項新品延續公司從雲端伺服器到地端運算的產品策略，但新聞稿未揭露銷量及營收貢獻，尚不能將它視為9月營收創高的主要原因。目前已反映在營運數字上的成長，仍以AI伺服器出貨為核心。
公司5月曾規劃，隨台灣、美國及馬來西亞等地新增產能陸續到位，全年伺服器產能將較去年翻倍；實際開出進度仍須由後續公司說明確認。接下來，第三季財報將先驗證營收超預期能否轉化為更高獲利，第四季則要看高規格機櫃出貨能否在新高基期上延續成長。

items.title: 〈焦點股〉東元續攻東南亞AIDC基建商機砸20億元擴大投資 價量齊揚
items.title_en: <Focus Stock> TECO Continues to Pursue Southeast Asia AIDC Infrastructure Opportunities, Investing Over NT$2 Billion to Expand; Price and Volume Rise Together
paras: 東元(1504-TW)持續鎖定東南亞AIDC基礎建設商機，日前更大手筆擴大投資，共斥資超過20億元投資馬來西亞、印尼等地，激勵東元今(7)日無懼大盤震盪，價量齊揚。
東元今天早盤以71.9元開高走高，盤中最高衝上73.9元，漲逾3%，截至11點40分，股價暫報73.2元，漲幅約2.95%，站穩所有均線，成交量超過2.2萬張。三大法人近日也持續敲進東元，連續5個交易日買超，合計買超4640張。
東元董事會日前通過3項投資案，積極搶攻AIDC基建商機，馬來西亞布局上，董事會通過由馬來西亞子公司TECO INDUSTRY (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD.，於現行承租的檳城土地新建廠房，總金額不超過新台幣5.03億元，主要因應業務發展及產能需求。
印尼部分，東元透過增資100%持股子公司UNITED INDUSTRY GLOBAL INVESTMENT不超過1000萬美元(約新台幣3.18億元)，將用於P.T TECO ELEKTRO INDONESIA興建改造既有廠房。另外，也規劃以不超過12.71億元，成立新加坡合資子公司，並設立印尼變壓器工廠。
東元指出，東南亞資料中心目前占整體資料中心接單3成，且明年動能及貢獻將更為顯著。
paras_en: TECO (1504‑TW) continues to target AIDC infrastructure opportunities in Southeast Asia, and recently made a large‑scale investment, spending more than NT$2 billion on projects in Malaysia, Indonesia and other locations, which helped TECO on the 7th rise despite market volatility, with both price and volume climbing.

In early trade today TECO opened at NT$71.9 and moved higher, reaching a intraday high of NT$73.9, up more than 3%. By 11:40 a.m. the price was NT$73.2, up about 2.95%, holding above all moving averages, with volume exceeding 22,000 lots. The three major institutional investors have been buying TECO for five consecutive trading days, netting a total purchase of 4,640 lots.

The TECO board recently approved three investment projects to aggressively capture AIDC infrastructure opportunities. For the Malaysia expansion, the board approved that its Malaysian subsidiary TECO INDUSTRY (MALAYSIA) SDN. BHD. will construct a new plant on leased land in Penang, with a total cost not exceeding NT$5.03 billion, to meet business growth and capacity needs.

In Indonesia, TECO will increase capital of its wholly‑owned subsidiary UNITED INDUSTRY GLOBAL INVESTMENT by up to US$10 million (about NT$3.18 billion) to fund the renovation and expansion of the existing P.T TECO ELEKTRO INDONESIA plant. In addition, TECO plans to invest up to NT$12.71 billion to establish a joint‑venture subsidiary in Singapore and set up an Indonesian transformer factory.

TECO notes that Southeast Asian data centers currently account for about 30% of its total data‑center orders, and the momentum and contribution from this region are expected to become even more significant next year.
